content: We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (result of make_5_lvl2-template_search-3) to the molecule. We have the target molecule list from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2: three SMILES strings (maybe product?). Those are likely the product molecules after applying template? Actually make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave list of product SMILES? It says "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below?" The answer gave list of SMILES strings (single element each) maybe the product? Actually they are likely the target molecules (the ones we need to apply template to). Now we need to get precursors by applying the template (found in make_5_lvl2-template_search-3) to those molecules. But that task failed to get template ID. We need to find the appropriate template that corresponds to DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde (break C-O bond, change bond order). So we need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken maybe "ester"? functional_groups_formed "aldehyde"? bonds_order_changed maybe C=O order changed from 2 to 1? Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target molecule being each of the three SMILES? Actually we need the template that when applied to the molecule (the product) reproduces the forward reaction (reduction). The product is aldehyde? The given SMILES seem complex with silyl groups etc. They likely are aldehyde products after DIBAL reduction of ester? The template would break an ester to aldehyde. So we can search for templates that break "ester" and form "aldehyde". Use functional_groups_broken=["ester"], functional_groups_formed=["aldehyde"]. Let's try.
